Subject: Private deployment pricing & support options

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. Fintrex is evaluating a private deployment (VPC-first, potential on-prem later) for our payments fraud models. Procurement asked me for a clear commercial picture so we can build an internal CAPEX/opex ask. High level context:

- Expected steady-state: 4 A100-equivalent GPUs (mixed batch/real-time), peak burst to ~8.
- We need SOC2 evidence, KMS integration for keys, and SSO (SAML).
- Target procurement / PO issuance window: mid-Jan (ideally by 2025-01-15).

Please send:
1) Pricing for a private VPC deployment: licensing model (term vs perpetual), platform fee structure, and recommended support tiers (response SLAs and cost).
2) Any standard SOW or example contract we can share with legal.
3) Typical migration/milestone schedule and one-time onboarding credits you offer.

Also flag any minimum commit or case where you require dedicated capacity reservations.

Appreciate a ballpark today — we can take a follow-up call next week to iron details.

Best,
Audrey
Head of Cloud Ops | Fintrex

--
Fintrex, Inc.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing & support options

Hi Audrey — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Quick ballpark below to help your procurement conversation; I'll attach our private terms + a sample SOW for legal.

Summary (ballpark, subject to usage profile & final sizing):
- Licensing: term-based subscription (12/36 month options). No perpetual license offered for hosted/private at present.
- Platform fee: base platform fee covers control plane, monitoring, and platform updates. Typical structure: $10k/mo (lists) for 4-GPU-equivalent footprint; discounts apply for committed terms.
- Support tiers (examples):
  * Standard: business-hours support, 48-hr P1 response, basic monitoring alerts (included with platform fee).
  * Business: 24x7 support, 8-hr P1 response, quarterly architecture reviews (+ ~12% of platform fee).
  * Enterprise: 24x7 dedicated on-call, 2-hr P1 SLA, runbooks and quarterly QBRs (+ ~25% of platform fee, includes initial onboarding days).
- One-time onboarding: typical 5 days of migration support included; additional days billed. We can offer a small migration credit for strategic pilots.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Terms_v3.pdf, SOW-Fintrex-2024.xlsx (sample milestones and phasing).

Next steps: If this aligns, I propose a short call with procurement/legal + Rishi (pricing) and Lauren (commercial ops) to map timeline. Do you have an internal target sign-by date?

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Dec 2024 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing & support options

Karthik / Lauren —

Quick internal note on potential commercial levers for Fintrex:
- Strategic discount: propose up to 18% off list platform fee for a 36-month committed term (we should target signed LOI by 2025-01-10 to hit quarterly targets).
- Onboarding credits: waive first month platform fee + include 2 additional migration days (rather than 5 included) as part of the package.
- Support packaging: include Business tier for year 1 (8-hr P1; 24x7 on-call) with ability to dilute to Standard at renewal.
- Legal: expect standard Redwood private terms redlines around data residency & indemnity. Ask legal if we can accept Fintrex's KMS requirements with our current key management integrations (this is typically doable but may require minor clause tweaks).

Risk note: if we go deeper on discounts we should require a minimum committed GPU-months (e.g., 36 GPU-months / quarter) so we can protect unit economics.

If OK, I can draft the commercial summary for the customer-facing quote and slot a DocuSign envelope.

-Rishi
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Dec 2024 10:06:00 -05:00

Agree with the approach. A couple of quick asks before committing to 18%:
- Confirm whether the first-month platform fee waiver will affect amortization/accounting ask from finance (they sometimes require it as a non-recurring credit).
- Add a usage-based auto-scale credit clause (if they exceed burst thresholds, we offer token credit to offset overage in year 1) — helps reduce sticker shock from spikes.

Once Rishi drafts the commercial summary, I’ll prep the final quote and DocuSign.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
